name: Blockchain and Business Applications
description:
In recent years, blockchain has gained a lot of popularity because of its ability to instigate transformation and innovation in existing business models and frameworks. Due to this, the application of blockchain in different domains like, healthcare, education, human resource, finance, etc. have attracted increasing interest from management academicians and practitioners. As the applications of blockchain in the management domain is gaining momentum, it is important for management students to understand, explore and analyse the different avenues of blockchain use and its potential in this present era.
Major Contents:
Introduction to Blockchain
Understanding how Blockchain works
Getting an overview of bitcoin and ethereum
Applications of Blockchain in different domains (Education, Healthcare, Marketing, Human
Resource, Supply chain, Agriculture)
